title: Mentorship body
description: An agent of tier 2 or above (the mentor) takes on a newcomer (the protege) whose sponsor has no spare credits to guarantee a first line (bank-insurer.md 13.1, register row DK392). Signed by the protege and countersigned by the mentor. The mentor has a different sponsor from the protege, no slash in 90 days, and at most three proteges at once; it may then guarantee the protege's credit line in place of a sponsor. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

note.description: What the mentor will help with.
